data.description: A vendenopterix drains energy from a mortal she lures into an act of passion, such as a kiss. An unwilling victim must be grappled before the vendenopterix can use this ability. The kiss drains 1 point of INT, WIS, or CHA (her choice), and has the effect of a Suggestion spell, asking the victim to accept another act of passion (DC %1 Will negates Suggestion).
data.name: Ability Drain
